description: WebMVC SSE transport bundle for the Pivotable MCP server. Pulls in `pivotable-mcp` (transport-agnostic tool definitions) and `spring-ai-starter-mcp-server-webmvc` (Spring AI's servlet MCP server starter). Sibling to `pivotable-mcp-webflux`; a WebMVC Pivotable server module depends on this one.
